# mDM MLP reference provenance

The three files in `fast_dictionary_generation_reference/` are an unmodified
reference subset from mDM commit `a24ab1008d48e92ddf6f2bb8131f9a58dda23e95`
on `master`. They are retained only to guide the later 12→200→200→200→10 MLP
implementation and its train/test structure. No EPG implementation was copied
as a formal teacher or online signal model.
